title: Headache & Migraine (Cephalalgia) — Dual-System Clinical Monograph
content:
Condition: Headache (Tension Headache & Migraine).
Allopathic Pharmacology: Paracetamol 500-650mg or Ibuprofen 400mg with food for tension headaches. For migraine: Sumatriptan 50mg (Rx only) or Naproxen 250mg. Avoid excessive painkiller overuse to prevent rebound headaches.
Ayurvedic Formulations: Shirashooladi Vajra Rasa (1 tablet twice daily), Brahmi Vati 250mg for stress-induced headaches, Peppermint / Eucalyptus oil temple massage, Shankhpushpi syrup.
Home Remedies: Cold compress on forehead or warm compress on neck, Ginger tea (inhibits prostaglandin synthesis), Acupressure on LI4 web space between thumb and index finger, Hydration with electrolyte water.
Emergency: Sudden severe 'thunderclap' headache, headache with blurred vision, fever, or neck stiffness requires emergency 112 triage.
